title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows, optimize cache & hygiene
author: Avery Chen
description: Summary: Consolidate disparate lint, test, and release GitHub Actions workflows into a smaller set of well-documented workflows; unify cache keys and build matrices; remove legacy node16 jobs; add hygiene steps to keep self-hosted runners healthy. Motivation: long-running CI maintenance, flaky caches, and duplicated workflow logic across repositories caused developer friction and unnecessary minutes. This PR consolidates workflows under .github/workflows/{lint-test.yml, release.yml, build-matrix.yml}, standardizes caching, and improves secrets/permissions scoping. Changes included: consolidated lint/test steps for TS/Python/Go, standardized Node version matrix to node18/node20 with build caching improvements, added conditional job for monorepo path filters, improved artifact retention policy, added retry and backoff for flaky network steps; updated docs and templates. Testing: validated on redwood monorepo and redwood-sdk-python/nightly with Canary branch; ran full CI (lint, unit, integration, e2e) on main flagged commits; observed ~22% reduction in average workflow runtime and 18% fewer cache misses in synthetic runs. Rollout: staged as opt-in initially via feature flag in actions, then switched to default after 48h of canary. Migration notes: repositories using old workflows should pick up new templates; provided retrofit guide under docs/ci/migration.md. Related: ENG-4521, ENG-4478; SUP-1123 (support incident for flaky release job). Checklist: - [x] Workflows implemented and linted - [x] Canary rollout validated - [x] Docs updated - [x] Owners notified. Known limitations: remaining python test matrix kept minimal to avoid long runtimes; follow-up to add targeted e2e caching (ENG-4602).
commits: feat(ci): add consolidated lint-test.yml and move TS/py/go jobs into unified workflow
feat(ci): add release.yml with tightened permissions and tag handling
perf(ci): unify cache keys and improve restore/save logic for node and python
docs(ci): add docs/ci/migration.md and update README with workflow owners
release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows for lint/test/release, optimized cache keys and matrices, removed Node16 jobs; documented migration steps.
